question: Two trains of lengths 250 metres and 350 metres will cross each other in _____ seconds when moving in opposite directions with speeds 35 km per hour and 25 km per hour.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Distance to cover = 250 + 350 = 600 m

Relative Speed (opposite directions) = 35 + 25 = 60 km/hr

Speed in m/s = 60 × (5/18) = 50/3 m/s

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed = 600 ÷ (50/3) = 36 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 36 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
